+ "\n    MPSGraphTensor *%s = \n    [graph                   %s:%s\n              spatialAxesTensor:%s\n                batchAxisTensor:%s\n          blockDimensionsTensor:%s\n           usePixelShuffleOrder:%s\n                           name:%s];\n    "
